answer: The strongest lever is simple: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because garden only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, pearl is enforced in the ledger: Withdrawal limits start near zero and open only against a measured history of accepted answers. Any jade approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
